nphi.title: TRIuMPH – upscaling the WHO TRIcycle protocol for One Health CPE surveillance
nphi.with: Institute for Medical Research Malaysia; Ministry of Health Malaysia; DVS Malaysia; NIH Pakistan; CICM Antananarivo; Université Paris Diderot; Fondation Mérieux; Utrecht University
nphi.summary: RIVM coordinates the project, which developed protocols and WGS pipelines for carbapenemase-producing Enterobacterales and tested them in one-year surveillance campaigns in three countries.

nphi.title: Planning week at RIVM to turn NIH Islamabad into Pakistan's NPHI
nphi.with: National Institute of Health (NIH) Islamabad; Public Health England; US CDC
nphi.summary: In 2017, a Pakistani NIH and ministry delegation spent a week at RIVM with IANPHI, PHE and US CDC. Together they drafted a vision, a mission and an action plan for turning NIH into a comprehensive NPHI.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P53 – Strengthening biosafety and biosecurity in Central Asia
nphi.with: ISTC (Kazakhstan); VERTIC; Public Health England; Sustainable Criminal Justice Solutions (lead)
nphi.summary: RIVM led the biosecurity training and supported the biosafety training, including hands-on BSL3 work, for national expert teams in seven countries.

nphi.title: CELESTA 2.0 – Genomic surveillance of outbreak-prone viral diseases
nphi.actor: Bernhard Nocht Institute for Tropical Medicine (BNITM)
nphi.with: CRV-LFHVG Conakry (Guinea); LFHV Guéckédou (Guinea); LFHV-HRNZE N'Zérékoré (Guinea); Irrua Specialist Teaching Hospital (Nigeria); Instituto Aggeu Magalhães, FIOCRUZ Recife (Brazil); National Institute for Research on Public Health INSPI (Ecuador); Udelar Evolutionary Genetics Section (Uruguay); Public Health Reference Laboratory Khyber Pakhtunkhwa & Institute of Public Health and Social Sciences, Khyber Medical University (Pakistan); KU Leuven (Belgium)
nphi.summary: Expands nanopore sequencing, mobile labs and training for genomic surveillance of emerging viral infections in Africa, Latin America and Pakistan, with an open analysis toolbox.

nphi.title: China CDC – NIH Pakistan memorandum of understanding
nphi.summary: MoU signed in February 2021 covering communicable disease prevention and control, laboratory quality and biosafety, and training in molecular diagnostics.

nphi.title: Global Laboratory Leadership Programme (GLLP)
nphi.with: WHO; ECDC; FAO; WOAH (OIE); Association of Public Health Laboratories; implementing countries incl. Pakistan and Liberia
nphi.summary: CDC co-developed the Global Laboratory Leadership Programme with WHO, ECDC, APHL, FAO and WOAH. Its One Health learning package trains national laboratory leaders and has been rolled out in countries including Pakistan and Liberia.

nphi.title: CDC–Pakistan NIH cooperation (surveillance, FELTP, GLLP)
nphi.summary: Under a cooperative agreement with Pakistan's NIH, CDC supported influenza sentinel surveillance from 2004, FELTP from 2006 (handed to government in 2021) and the Global Laboratory Leadership Programme from 2019.

nphi.title: IHR Strengthening Project
nphi.with: National public health institutes and ministries of health; Africa CDC (regional)
nphi.summary: DHSC-funded programme, implemented by UKHSA, to help partner countries prevent, detect and respond to health threats and meet IHR (2005) requirements. Also works regionally via Africa CDC, in the Eastern Mediterranean and in South-East…

nphi.title: EMPHNET FETP exchange: Pakistan residents hosted at IEDCR Bangladesh
nphi.actor: Institute of Epidemiology, Disease Control and Research (IEDCR)
nphi.summary: Two FETP Pakistan residents spent two weeks at IEDCR in Dhaka (scientific writing, surveillance site visits, emergency operations simulation, DHIS2/QGIS/R/PHEOC training) with Bangladeshi fellows and mentors.

nphi.title: Specialised field epidemiology cohorts on respiratory viruses in Lebanon and Pakistan (PHEP-RV)
nphi.with: Lebanon Ministry of Public Health Epidemiological Surveillance Program; Lebanese Red Cross; Ministry of Agriculture; Sindh provincial health institutions / FELTP Pakistan
nphi.summary: EMPHNET-supported 2026 cohorts: Lebanon's FETP cohort 7 (21 residents) and a Sindh, Pakistan cohort (26 participants) trained in respiratory virus surveillance and response.

nphi.title: EMPHNET FETP exchange: Afghan residents hosted by FELTP Pakistan at NIH Islamabad
nphi.actor: National Institute of Health, Pakistan (FELTP Pakistan)
nphi.summary: Two FETP Afghanistan residents visited FELTP Pakistan and the NIH in Islamabad under the EMPHNET exchange scheme (December 2022 to February 2023 reporting period).

nphi.title: Gates-funded Integrated Disease Surveillance project
nphi.with: INS Mozambique; NIH Pakistan; others not named
nphi.summary: In 2022, IANPHI ran a Gates-funded study of integrated disease surveillance. It made country deep dives in Mozambique, Pakistan, Malawi, Uganda, England, Sweden and Canada, and held a webinar with NIH Pakistan and INS Mozambique.

nphi.title: New Variant Assessment Platform (NVAP) – international genomic surveillance partnerships
nphi.with: National partners in nine countries/territories; WHO EMRO sequencing hubs (Oman, Abu Dhabi, Morocco); Africa CDC; CARPHA
nphi.summary: Set up by PHE in 2021 and continued by UKHSA, NVAP provides sequencing reagents, training in bioinformatics and variant risk assessment, and scientific exchanges to partner countries and regional bodies.

nphi.title: Global AR Lab & Response Network – drug-resistant fungi projects with NPHIs
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS) Colombia; National Center for Disease Control and Public Health (NCDC) Georgia; National Institute of Health (NIH) Pakistan
nphi.summary: Under the Global Antimicrobial Resistance Laboratory and Response Network (launched 2021), CDC funds national public health institutes in Colombia, Georgia and Pakistan to detect and track drug-resistant fungal pathogens such as Candida…

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Pakistan (phases 1 and 2)
nphi.with: National Institute of Health (NIH) Islamabad; Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine; Health Security Partners; Indus Hospital Health Network; Shifa International Hospital; Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan
nphi.summary: DAI-led Fleming Fund grant that strengthened Pakistan's One Health AMR surveillance, including ISO 15189 accreditation, whole-genome sequencing and GLASS reporting at NIH, which hosts the national AMR secretariat.

nphi.title: GOARN in the Eastern Mediterranean: partner institutions and 2019-2020 deployments
nphi.actor: GOARN Eastern Mediterranean partner institutions (incl. NIH Pakistan, Institut Pasteur Tunis, EMPHNET)
nphi.with: National Institute of Health Pakistan; Institut Pasteur du Maroc; Institut Pasteur de Tunis; Institut Pasteur of Iran; EMPHNET; Ministries of Health
nphi.summary: 17 partner institutions from 12 countries support outbreak deployments, e.g. 25 experts to the Larkana HIV outbreak in Pakistan, cholera in Yemen, floods in Iran and measles in Tunisia (2019-2020).

nphi.title: CDC support to national public health institute development
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute; NCDC Nigeria; INS Mozambique; Zambia NPHI; others
nphi.summary: CDC's overview of countries where it helps establish or strengthen national public health institutes (strategic planning, surveillance, laboratory systems, workforce, emergency response).
